title: introduce-intercluster-slack-orchestrator-and-spillover-throttler
author: Anya Patel
description: Motivation: Dedicated clusters occasionally hit simultaneous microburst demand across AZs, which caused asymmetric eviction and poor tenant fairness when one cluster absorbed spillover while others throttled aggressively. This PR implements an Intercluster Slack Orchestrator (ISO) and a complementary Spillover Throttler (ST) to coordinate transient slack pooling, improve cross-cluster fairness, and surface utilization signals for billing and SLOs. Design summary: ISO maintains soft "slabs" of capacity that can be loaned across clusters for short windows; slabs are tracked per-tenant and per-priority window, and reclaimed with non-blocking backpressure signals. ST applies a graceful spillover policy that converts sudden overcommit into prioritized, time-decayed throttles rather than immediate drops, enabling downstream retries to succeed without wide-scale evictions. Implementation notes: adds slab allocator module, spillover controller, tenant-level lease bookkeeping, delta-based telemetry hooks, and new prometheus metrics (redwood_iso_loaned_slabs_total, redwood_st_active_spillovers, redwood_tenant_spill_latency_p50/p95). Rollout and safety: feature gated behind runtime.featureFlags.interclusterSlack; default off for Dedicated until feature flag is enabled for select tenants. Includes canary rollout plan: 5% of Dedicated clusters -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%, with automated rollback if tenant_throttle_rate > 2% or p95-latency regression > 10% over baseline for 30m. Related work: builds on ENG-3421 (telemetry standardization) and ENG-3490 (tenant throttle interfaces). Checklist: [x] slab allocator algorithms implemented and covered by unit tests, [x] integration test harness for 2-cluster failover scenarios, [x] e2e perf job added to benchmark-lab with synthetic microbursts, [x] docs updated in redwood-docs/observability about new metrics, [x] rollout playbook added to runbooks/runbooks/intercluster-slack.md. Backwards compatibility: API surface is internal to runtime; no breaking API changes to customer-facing endpoints. Observability: added dashboards and alert rules in observability-pack to track spillover ratio and cross-cluster fairness index. Summary: improves tenant fairness during short bursts, reduces noisy evictions, and provides actionable telemetry for capacity planning.

review_comments: Liam Chen: Can you clarify the slab lifetime and reclamation guarantees? If a slab is loaned and the donor cluster suddenly regains load, how do we prioritize reclaim vs. fairness?

Anya Patel: Slab lifetime defaults to 90s; reclamation is best-effort preemption with exponential backoff for borrowers. Donor reclaim requests carry a priority tag; ST will convert low-priority loans into decayed throttles first. I added a paragraph in slab_allocator.go and unit tests that simulate donor bounce scenarios.
Marcos Rivera: Tests look good; please add a small e2e that verifies no tenant sees >10% p95 regression under a two-node microburst with spillover enabled.
Anya Patel: Added a benchmark-lab job 'microburst-canary' and an e2e assertion in integration harness. Results attached to PR comment (raw metrics).
Sofia Kumar: Telemetry naming nit: prefer 'loaned_slabs' over 'iso_loaned' for consistency with existing metric prefixes. Also please ensure labels include 'tenant' and 'priority'.
Anya Patel: Renamed metric to redwood_loaned_slabs_total and added tenant/priority labels. Updated dashboards accordingly.
Liam Chen: CI flake on coordinator_test.go - re-ran and fixed race by switching to RWMutex; looks good now. Approving.
Marcos Rivera: Approving after small comment on doc phrasing; thanks.
ci_summary: Initial CI run failed (race in coordinator_test.go); race fixed and subsequent run passed. Lint and unit tests green. Integration suite for 2-cluster scenarios ran successfully in staging with perf delta within thresholds.
release_notes:
- Added Intercluster Slack Orchestrator (ISO) to enable short-term capacity loans across Dedicated clusters.
- Added Spillover Throttler (ST) to apply time-decayed throttles during overcommit, reducing evictions.
- New metrics: redwood_loaned_slabs_total, redwood_st_active_spillovers, redwood_tenant_spill_latency_p50/p95.
- Rollout is feature-gated; see runbooks/runbooks/intercluster-slack.md for plan and abort criteria.
notes_for_oncall: If alerts for 'intercluster_spill_ratio' or tenant_throttle_rate exceed thresholds during rollout, immediately flip runtime.featureFlags.interclusterSlack=false and follow rollback playbook. Check 'loaned_slabs' metric to confirm loans reclaimed. If persistent imbalance, escalate to SRE and ENG-3490 owner.
